items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: the guy that took over for me was Billy May, who was playing trumpet in the band when I was writing for it

ctx.x: To write stuff swinging when it’s soft.

Sure and not be spraying your trumpets up in high C’s and high D’s and all of that. But that was my first big band. And then I got drafted. And at the time — there’s a little story with this if you’re interested. Ozzie and Harriet had their own show. And I was stationed in Long Beach so conceivably maybe I could get up to them, while I was in an Army band. But unfortunately there was no way that I could keep writing the bridges and cues and everything, and I had written the bridges and cues for Ozzie’s band when…
Did Ozzie have you on a salary?
